items.question: Which UAE ministry launched and manages the Investor Navigator heatmap of economic sectors?
items.gold: The Ministry of Economy launched and manages the Investor Navigator.
items.fact: Ministry of Economy launched and manages Investor Navigator heatmap

items.question: What information does the Investor Navigator heatmap give investors about each economic sector?
items.gold: Growth rate, existing projects, future trends, growth outlook, and government stakeholders in each sector.
items.fact: Investor Navigator heatmap shows five sector information categories
